title: Suspected cholera case definition

prerequisites.match_logic: Outside a declared outbreak: acute watery diarrhoea AND severe dehydration AND age 2 years or more, OR death from acute watery diarrhoea. Where an outbreak is declared: acute watery diarrhoea (or death from it) at any age
symptoms_or_findings: severe dehydration (needed only outside an outbreak)
patient_factors: Outside an outbreak: age 2 years or more
Where an outbreak is declared: any age

recommended_action: Treat as suspected cholera and go on to assess dehydration. If the case definition is not met, manage outside the cholera pathway. This is a suspected (probable) diagnosis only: the supplied pages give no laboratory confirmation step.

exclusions: Outside a declared outbreak, a child under 2 years does not meet the definition even with watery diarrhoea
missing_info_to_ask: Is a cholera outbreak declared locally?
Is the diarrhoea acute and watery?
caveats: Laboratory confirmation is not covered in the assigned pages, so output must say 'suspected/probable'
